# Cesium lifetime source data

The three files `fig3_info.json`, `fig3_fluorescence_histo.npz` and `fig3_reference_histo.npz` are unmodified members of `histograms.zip`, from **S. Pucher, P. Schneeweiss, A. Rauschenbeutel and A. Dareau**, *Precise Lifetime Measurement of the Cesium 5²D₅⁄₂ State*, Zenodo, [10.5281/zenodo.3701333](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3701333), related to *Lifetime measurement of the cesium 5²D₅⁄₂ state*, Physical Review A 101, 042510 (2020), [10.1103/PhysRevA.101.042510](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.101.042510).

The dataset metadata specifies **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International**, [license terms](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). That license governs the source data; the repository license does not replace it. No endorsement by the source authors is implied. Retrieved 2026-10-10.

The complete 11,101,007-byte source archive was downloaded and its published MD5 `79d910aa0505a127717d3d742870240a` verified. Its SHA256 is `4350154bc943bb7c58c7240455d4ff0429234d3f442c3fcb2a27c19cfe78326b`. `manifest.json` is our provenance and inspection summary, including original member paths and SHA256 identities. The original bytes are preserved by Git attributes. NumPy files were loaded with `allow_pickle=False`.

The separate author scripts were inspected outside this repository. Their own headers specify CC-BY-SA-4.0; none is copied or adapted here. The large raw-delay archives were not downloaded. The selected histograms cannot establish independent retained sampling, category efficiency bounds or geometric anchor calibration. See [the adequacy screen](../../physical-data-screen.md).
